note: LibreOffice application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for application commands (File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Tools, Window, Help) and their sub-items

Spreadsheet sheet tab list -- renders operator-defined sheet names (e.g., Sheet1, Sheet2) which are part of the document structure and not free-form user content in the context of the application interface
LibreOffice toolbars -- render fixed operator vocabulary for standard application actions (Save, Print, Copy, Paste, formatting controls, etc.)
Application status bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for status indicators (Ready, cell reference, zoom level, etc.)
